targets.per_question: an ordered, non-empty list; no duplicate target

ref_rules.repo: path; relative to the firing repo root, or absolute for another checkout
ref_rules.local: <probe-id>[:<arg>]; the id is a probe_allowlist id, an arg only for an entry whose ref is not 'none', arg charset [A-Za-z0-9._-]+

ask_md_grammar.section_body: one target line per target in list order, a blank line, then the question text
ask_md_grammar.mixed_question: a 'Target: web' line is written like any other target
ask_md_grammar.questions_list: with two or more questions, the ask text is followed by 'Research questions:' and a numbered list
ask_md_grammar.combine_section: ## question: a numbered list of every question; each item puts its first target line on the number line and indents the rest, then the text

lists.questions: one slug per question; the single item 'question' in combine mode
lists.probes: slugs of questions with a local target; in combine mode the single item 'question' when any question has a local target

flags.local_probe: bound true only when a local target exists; the manifest declares it [true, false], so an unbound flag reads false and the probe stage is skipped

probe_allowlist.reports: file names and sizes under ~/.claude/, depth 2
service and account names of entries whose service matches the ref suffix, never a secret

counts and existence of Perforce depots, clients, streams, users, groups, labels and servers, plus whether the authenticated CLI reaches a server; never file contents, credentials, or workspace, host or user values
probe_allowlist.ref: a verb from verbs, substituted for {ref}

verbs.info: whether the authenticated CLI reaches a server

probe_rules.cli_class: an entry with class 'cli' names a tool and a verbs map (verb to the question it answers); the ref is one listed verb, any other verb is refused, and no verb may mutate; a cli command declares no output filter, so the report is reduced to counts and presence by the shape rule

close.refuses_when: grounding.md is absent or empty, or grades a claim ungrounded or contradicted, rules a contradiction invented, or grades no claim of a digest
close.digest_build: sorted digest-*.md bodies, then '## Grounding' and the grounding.md body

cli.ask: repeatable; every --ask is one question; a single --ask behaves as a one-question split
cli.target: --target web|repo=PATH|local=PROBE, repeatable, each binding to the preceding --ask; an identical repeat is refused

sizing.question_targets: research.question_targets[] of {question, source, ref?}, question 1-based, an index repeating for a list
